[SWS_CRYPT_20001]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
CryptoAPI
provides a secure local access
to specific information. The minimal information, which shall be accessable, are
the specific system name, the private key, which is associated with the caller, the
name of the
CA
, which is used as a trust authority, and the
ara::crypto::x509::
X509PublicKeyInfo
(or a fingerprint of the public key where a self-certified version
is available elsewhere).
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02306)
